units.text: The Vienna Convention on the Law of Treaties entered into force on 27 January 1980, in accordance with article 84(1).

judgement.reason: The UNTC passage expressly states the entry into force date as 27 January 1980, in accordance with article 84(1), matching the statement.

units.text: The same convention was registered with the United Nations on 27 January 1980 under registration number 18232.

judgement.reason: The passage states registration on 27 January 1980, No. 18232, directly matching the statement.
